notes.title: BREAKFALL September Update V 1.0.4
notes.content: [p]Dear Community, Update 1.0.4 is now available and contains changes in the game mechanics which are listed as follows[/p][p][b][u]Most important Update Notes - Version 1.0.4[/u][/b][/p][p]- Added new level "Industrial Complex"[/p][p]- Added new type of NPC[/p][p]- Added new weapons[/p][p]- Added new sound effects[/p][p]- Refined character movement[/p][p]- Added new obstacle movement[/p][p][/p][p] [b][u]Most important Bug Fixes - Version 1.0.3[/u][/b][/p][p]- Fixed a bug where climbing obstacles didnt work as intended[/p][p]There are more minor bug-fixes[/p]

notes.title: BREAKFALL August Update V 1.0.3
notes.content:
[p]Dear Community, Update 1.0.3 is now available and contains changes in the game mechanics which are listed as follows  

[/p][p][b][u]Most important Update Notes - Version 1.0.3[/u][/b][/p][p]- Added Radioactive Zones together with a Geiger Counter in the HUD[/p][p]- Added radioactively contaminated items[/p][p]- Added new workshop 'Decontaminate Station"[/p][p]- Added new sound effects[/p][p]- Updated weather effects[/p][p]- Updated Item loot balancing[/p][p]- Updated Sound Effects for certain Items[/p][p]- Refined Fights with AI enemies[/p][p]- Added war background atmosphere[/p][p]- Added a war atmosphere cycle throughout game loop with a "nuclear highlight"[/p][p]- Added a Geiger Counter HUD Effect[/p][p]- Added Quicktime-Event "Evade" during melee combat fights[/p][p]- Added Character Skill "Bouncer" where a character auto-evades and has more powerful punches during close combat[/p][p]- Added WASD Movement during Place-Actor 

[/p][p] [b][u]Most important Bug Fixes - Version 1.0.3[/u][/b][/p][p]- Fixed a bug where bear trap placement didn't work as intended[/p][p]- Fixed a bug where Interaction was not certainly aborted while fighting[/p][p]- Fixed a bug where Camera movement didn't work properly while placing a building object[/p][p]- Fixed a bug where walking through unlocked door was not possible[/p][p]- Fixed a bug where interaction was aborted[/p][p]- Fixed a bug where ledge-mantling did not work as intended 

[/p][p]There are many more bug-fixes, but these are the most important ones[/p]

notes.title: BREAKFALL July Update V 1.0.2
notes.content:
[p]Dear Community, Update 1.0.2 is now available and contains changes in the game mechanics which are listed as follows[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Update Notes - Version 1.0.2[/u][/b] [/p][p]
- Updated UI for "Ending/Completion"-Screen.

- Updated logic for deadly scenarios

- Updated camera movement for smoother experience

- Updated Level "Apartment Building"  

- New "Goals"-Mechanic added in HUD for local and global ingame goals  

- New "Goal" on Level "Apartment Building"  

- Added new sound effects  

- Added new character movement and animation behaviour according to attribute values (like tiredness, sickness, woundness)[/p]

notes.title: BREAKFALL June Update V 1.0.1
notes.content:
Dear Community, Update 1.0.1 is now available and contains changes in the game mechanics which are listed as follows


[b]Update Notes - Version 1.0.1[/b]

- Added Item Chestlight

- Added Mechanic to wear Item Chestlight

- Created Effects Bar in HUD to display different Toggleable Items and Character Effects

- Added Item Bear Trap

- Added Mechanic to place Bear Trap / Player can be trapped too.

- Updated certain Character profiles and models

- Added Item Grenade

- Updated Crafting Tables to craft new items

- Added Item & Mechanics for Gas Mask

- Added new Characters

- Refined the Animation System & added new animations

- Added Localization for German / Chinese / Russian / Japanese
